text:
maria: Heads up — CI on main is red for some serializer snapshots that look like kv-cache output drift. Anyone already triaging?

ci-bot: [CI] job failed: https://ci.internal/12345 · failed tests: tests/serialization/test_kv_prefix.py::test_prefix_cache_serialization (snapshot mismatch)

choi: :eyes: I can take a look. Can you paste the failing diff or repro steps?

maria: Repro locally with: `pytest tests/serialization -k kv_prefix -q --snapshot-update=no` — don't update snapshots. Diff shows reordered entries in the serialized kv prefix.

kevin: I ran that and see the same. There's an extra trailing \u0000 byte in some token spans in the new output. My hunch: tokenizer tweak in PR #462 changed token termination handling.

jess: Another angle: we changed kv-cache eviction ordering two weeks ago, could be non-deterministic serialization order now. Try normalizing keys before dump to confirm.

maria: Can someone rerun CI with `REDWOOD_KV_CACHE_VERSION=legacy` to see if it's a serialization change vs tokenization?

devops-bot: Rerun requested by @choi — job restarted: https://ci.internal/12345

choi: Rerun completed — green with legacy, red on default. So it's definitely tied to the new kv cache behavior.

kevin: OK that narrows it. Suggest a bisect to find the commit that introduced the ordering change. Quick bisect steps:
```
git bisect start
git bisect bad main
git bisect good v2026-02-18
# run the snapshot test fast
pytest tests/serialization/test_kv_prefix.py::test_prefix_cache_serialization -q
```
If it fails deterministically we can narrow to a single commit.

maria: @infra-oncall can you run a buildfarm bisect if local bisect is too slow? Range likely small but some machines take ages to run full env.

infra-oncall: I can. Post the suspect commit range and any flakiness notes and I will run the bisect overnight. Include flaky markers (none observed locally so far).

maria: Range: a1b2c3d..d4e5f6a — PR #462 touched both tokenizer and kvcache.

choi: I'll start a local bisect now; if it stalls I'll hand off to infra. If anyone else hits a faster repro, paste results here.

kevin: Short-term mitigation idea: add a compatibility shim that sorts prefix keys deterministically before serialization. Cheap patch we can roll out to Dedicated quickly while we bisect. Not ideal but reduces customer impact.

jess: Also run `pytest -k prompt_render --snapshot` to make sure the tokenizer drift didn't affect prompt snapshots elsewhere. I saw one unrelated prompt diff earlier today.

maria: Good call. I'll open a tracking ticket and tag customers in support. If bisect lands on PR #462 we should consider a revert or targeted fix.

choi: Update: local bisect hit commit 3f7e9c2 — looks like a change in the serialization comparator. Posting minimal repro and diff in a follow-up message.

maria: Nice work. Please add the minimal test to reproduce so CI will catch it in the future.

maria: :thumbsup:
